name: Nimbuss · Gremlet #9
description:
A kitten made of cloud fluff. It drizzles a little when it's sad and floats when it's happy.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Nimbuss in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
